header: One row per channel, the value on the link
lead: The whole list is an address element. The channel word comes before the value in the source order, so a screen reader announces what is being dialled before it reads the digits.
note: The icon is decoration on top of that word and carries aria-hidden — nothing in this element depends on a reader recognising a glyph.
